question: 单项选择：_____ I please use your pen? A. Can  B. Could  C. Will  D. Would
answer: 答案：B. Could。解析：Could I please + 动词原形是最委婉的请求许可。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：— ______ (Could) I please have some more tea? — Of course. Here you are.
answer: 答案：Could。解析：Could I please...?是请求许可的委婉句型。

question: 单项选择：— Could I please borrow your ruler? — _____ A. Sure, here you are  B. Yes, I could  C. No, you couldn't  D. Sure, I would
answer: 答案：A. Sure, here you are。解析：Could I please...?的肯定回答：Sure, here you are.

question: 翻译句子：请问我可以借你的字典吗？
answer: 答案：Could I please borrow your dictionary? 解析：Could I please + 动词原形。

question: 单项选择：Could I please _____ to the teacher after class? A. speak  B. speaking  C. to speak  D. spoke
answer: 答案：A. speak。解析：Could I please + 动词原形。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：— ______ (Could) I please go home now? — Sure, you can.
answer: 答案：Could。解析：Could I please...?是委婉请求许可。

question: 单项选择：Could I please have _____ to drink? A. anything  B. something  C. nothing  D. everything
answer: 答案：B. something。解析：Could I please have something...?是请求得到某物的委婉方式。

question: 单项选择：Could I please _____ the window? It's hot. A. open  B. opening  C. to open  D. opened
answer: 答案：A. open。解析：Could I please + 动词原形。

question: 翻译句子：请问老师我可以交作业吗？
answer: 答案：Could I please hand in my homework, teacher? 解析：hand in"上交"。

question: 单项选择：— Could I please sit here? — _____ A. Yes, I would  B. Sure, please  C. No, thanks  D. Yes, you do
answer: 答案：B. Sure, please。解析：Could I please...?的肯定回答：Sure, please / Of course / Yes, please.
